
==Japanese==
'''Ōmiwa Shrine''' (大神神社、おおみわじんじゃ、おおがじんじゃ) refers to Shinto shrines with the name "大神".

==Kantō Region==
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Shimotsuke)]] ([[Tochigi Prefecture]] [[Tochigi (city)|Tochigi]]) – A [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]] of [[Tsuga district]] in [[Shimotsuke Province]].
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Ōtawara)]] (Tochigi Prefecture, [[Ōtawara]])

==Chūbu Region==
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine, Ichinomiya|Ōmiwa Shrine (Ichinomiya)]] ([[Aichi Prefecture]] [[Ichinomiya, Aichi]] Hanaike) – A [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]] of [[Nakashima district]] in [[Owari Province]], possibly considered the [[Ichinomiya]] of Owari.
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Ichinomiya, Yamatocho Oho)]] (Ichinomiya, Aichi, Yamatocho Oho)
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Ichinomiya, Yamatocho Miyaji)]] (Ichinomiya, Aichi, Yamatocho Miyaji)
* [[Oomiwa Shrine]] ([[Gifu Prefecture]] [[Ōgaki]]) – A [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]] in [[Tagi district]] in [[Mino Province]].
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Ikeda, Gifu)]] (Gifu Prefecture, [[Ikeda, Gifu]], [[Ibi District, Gifu]])
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Iga)]] ([[Mie Prefecture]] [[Iga, Mie]])
* [[Q11371507]] ([[Shizuoka Prefecture]] [[Kosai, Shizuoka]]) – Identified with an Ōmiwa Shrine.

==Kinki Region==
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Nagahama)]] ([[Shiga Prefecture]] [[Nagahama, Shiga|Nagahama]])
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine]] ([[Sakurai, Nara]], [[Nara Prefecture]]) – A [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]] of [[Shikijō district]] in [[Yamato Province]] ([[Myōjin Taisha]]), historically known as "Ōmiwa Ōmononushi Jinja," a former [[Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|Kanpei-taisha]].
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Yamatokoriyama)]] (Nara Prefecture, [[Yamatokōriyama|Yamatokoriyama]])
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine (Nara City)]] (Nara Prefecture, [[Nara (city)|Nara]])
* [[Daijingūsha]] ([[Minamiyamashiro, Kyoto|Minamiyamashiro]], [[Kyoto Prefecture]])

==Chūgoku Region==
* [[Ōga Shrine]] ([[Okayama]] [[Central District|Naka-ku, Okayama]], [[Okayama Prefecture]]) – A [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]] in [[Jōtō district]] in [[Bizen Province]].

==Kyushu Region==
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine|Ōmiwa Shrine (Takami-dai, Fukuoka)]] ([[Fukuoka]] [[東區|Higashi-ku, Fukuoka]] Takami-dai)
* [[Ōmiwa Shrine|Ōmiwa Shrine (Wajirogaoka, Fukuoka)]] (Fukuoka City, Higashi-ku, Wajirogaoka)
